mapper.update: update tch_infor set tch_password=#{password} where tch_id=#{id}
update grades set grades.grade=#{grade} where s_id=#{id} and c_id=#{courseId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT c.c_id FROM course c LEFT JOIN t_teacher_course ttc ON c.c_id = ttc.c_id WHERE ttc.t_id=#{id}

select g.grade,si.stu_id,c.c_name,si.stu_name,g.c_id from grades g right join course c on g.c_id = c.c_id LEFT JOIN t_teacher_course ttc on ttc.c_id = c.c_id LEFT JOIN tch_infor ti on ttc.t_id = ti.tch_id left join stu_infor si on si.stu_id=g.s_id where g.c_id= #{courseID}
